annotations.title: Suggest niches from what is recorded

description: Up to 3 ranked niche suggestions from what is already recorded: the account's bio, the hashtags and words in its recorded posts, its competitors and the workspace voice. Rules only: it counts hits against curated hashtag and keyword lists, so each suggestion carries the matched tags and words. Nothing is saved. Check it against what you know, then save with niche_set. Empty suggestions: too little is recorded; ask the person or use posts_import and own_posts_record first.

account_id.description: One account. Omit to use every account in the workspace

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
